prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1131; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other driver was changing lanes. The reported mechanism of injury to the right knee is consistent with this type of crash. Initial evaluation documented pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Some examination findings, including localized tenderness and a positive effusion sign, support the reported injury, while other tests, including ligament stability assessment and neurovascular checks, returned normal results. No prior injury or treatment to the same knee is known to this provider. Over the course of care the patient attended 22 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this injury pattern; progress was gradual and included physical therapy, activity modification, and home exercise. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Patient is currently improving and is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued conservative care.
